title: MaRVL-QA: A Benchmark for Mathematical Reasoning over Visual Landscapes

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the model's accuracy on counting bright, highly salient features (local maxima/peaks) versus darker, less salient features (local minima/valleys) to identify perception gaps.

Analyzing the distribution of incorrect predictions and model failure modes in multiple-choice transformation tasks to detect rigid, non-reasoning preferences for specific answers (e.g., defaulting to 'No Change', 'Translation in X', or 'Rotate 180 Degrees').
